data.body:
STRUCTURAL ROOT CAUSE IDENTIFIED — story-decomposer agent is blind to Closure Checks.

User question during epic 3e36 ramp-up: "We have seen a degradation in epic results since implementing the SC/CC split. Are both SC and CC being considered when creating Stories?"

Empirical audit of plugins/dso/agents/story-decomposer.md (370+ lines) and plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md Phase H:

  1. story-decomposer.md mentions "Success Criteria" 8+ times, "sc-1/sc-2/sc-N" extensively.
  2. story-decomposer.md mentions "Closure Check" ZERO times. (grep -niE 'closure[- ]?check' returns empty.)
  3. preplanning SKILL.md Phase H Step extracts SC and passes as {sc_list} into the decomposer prompt. CC is never extracted or passed.
  4. The `← Validates Closure Check: "<text>"` DD traceability form is documented (SKILL.md:809-813) but is structurally unreachable by decomposer output because the decomposer doesn't see CCs.
  5. completion-verifier accepts ← Satisfies: AND ← Validates Closure Check: as valid traceability links — but if no DD points at a CC, completion verification flows entirely through SC-bound DDs.

This is a structural twin to bug 1761's core finding. SCs tend to describe outcomes ("the bridge mirrors Jira → local"); CCs tend to describe how we know we got there (durable invariants, integration test passes, LIVE-VERIFIED evidence). By dropping CC from decomposition input, the toolchain quietly excluded the behavior layer from DD authoring.

Epic 4047 fits the pattern. SCs in that epic were behavioral targets at face value, but the deepest "do the apply leaves write data" assertion was a CC concern (durable end-state) not an SC concern (outcome) — and it never landed in any story's DDs because no DD could reference it.

REMEDIATION CANDIDATE (highest priority, applies to the toolchain itself):

  1. Extract `## Closure Checks` items from the epic alongside `## Success Criteria` in preplanning Phase H.
  2. Pass both sets into the story-decomposer prompt with stable identifiers (`sc-1...sc-N`, `cc-1...cc-M`).
  3. Update story-decomposer to produce a `cc_coverage_plan` parallel to its `sc_coverage_plan`, ensuring every CC has at least one story DD with a `← Validates Closure Check:` link.
  4. Validation: an audit (run on every epic close) confirms every CC has at least one DD link across all stories.
  5. Backfill: for epics where the gap already shipped, the obligation-monitor (story 9b61 of this epic) could be extended to detect ungrounded CCs and file follow-on stories.

This finding belongs in this bug's remediation candidate list. It is the most actionable single change.
